subject: Invoice delivery governance and hybrid option (portal push + email copies)
messages:
From: Sandra Lewis <sandra.lewis@helixhealth.com>
To: connor.obrien@redwood.com
Cc: tanders@helixhealth.com
Date: Wed, 9 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice delivery: supplier onboarding + preferred channel

Hi Connor,

Hope you’re well. We’re starting vendor onboarding for Redwood across four Helix legal entities and need to lock down invoice delivery and billing contact details. Our AP team prefers to receive certified e-invoices via our portal (Peppol/SFTP integration) but we also need email copies for some legacy entities while they come online.

Can you confirm:
- Whether Redwood can push invoices to the Helix portal (we can provide endpoint details) AND send an email PDF copy to ap@helixhealth.com for a subset of subsidiaries during the transition.
- The payload fields you include (we need PO number, remit-to entity, VAT tax tag). I attached a short template of the fields our AP requires.
- Expected cutover timeline and a test invoice plan

We also need VAT certificate proof for EU invoicing and a single point of contact for billing disputes.

Attachments: InvoiceSpec_Template.xlsx

Thanks,
Sandra Lewis
Head of AP Operations
Helix Health

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Sandra Lewis <sandra.lewis@helixhealth.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 9 Jun 2027 10:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery: supplier onboarding + preferred channel

Thanks Sandra — appreciate the clear ask. Short answers up front: yes, we support a hybrid flow (portal push + emailed PDF copies) and can include the PO/VAT tags you need. Details below and next steps.

What Redwood can do
- Push: We can post e-invoice payloads (JSON/XML) to an endpoint (Peppol/SFTP/webhook) with signed metadata.
- Email copies: we will send invoice PDFs to ap@helixhealth.com and additional addresses you designate.
- Payload fields: we include PO number, billing entity ID, VAT rate, VAT amount, line-level tax tags, remit-to legal name and tax id. If you need a specific XML schema we can generate it.

Constraints and exceptions
- For entities that cannot onboard to the portal in the pilot window, we can accept email-only delivery but we require the VAT evidence file (scanned certificate) and a signed acceptance on file (for audit).
- SFTP fallback: available as a fallback if your portal team prefers pull vs push.

Recommended next steps
1) Kimberly (cc’d) will be the Redwood billing owner for this onboarding and will share our onboarding checklist and test dashboard.
2) Please send a sample PO and the vendor remit mapping for each legal entity (example: Helix Ltd — remit ID 4401).
3) We’ll schedule a 30-min test on the week of 6/21 to push a test invoice and confirm line-level tax mapping.

I’ve attached our e-invoice spec for your integration team. If this works, Kimberly will follow up with a checklist and timeline.

Attachment: redwood_einvoice_spec.pdf

—
Connor O'Brien
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0126

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: connor.obrien@redwood.com
Cc: Sandra Lewis <sandra.lewis@helixhealth.com>, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery: supplier onboarding + preferred channel

Adding a bit more operational detail from Redwood billing:

Operational proposal
- Pilot: We recommend starting with one Helix legal entity on portal push + email copy, then onboard the remaining three on a weekly cadence.
- Exception window: For subsidiaries that cannot provision portal access within 30 days, we will allow email-only delivery for up to 90 days provided the VAT cert is received and matched to the invoice.
- PO matching: We will validate PO number presence on all invoices; mismatches will generate an AP exception flag and an automated notification to the billing contact.

Checklist and artifacts
- I attached our onboarding checklist (portal_onboarding_checklist.xlsx) — it lists required sample files, endpoint cert fingerprints, and testing steps.
- We will need: sample PO (preferably PDF), VAT certificate (scanned), and the remit mapping spreadsheet.

Timeline proposal
- 6/21–6/25: test push for pilot entity
- 6/28–7/09: onboarding remaining entities in parallel (one/week)
- 7/15: target full handoff (exceptions closed)

If Helix needs a longer exception period we can escalate to product for an accommodation, but we prefer to limit email-only windows for audit and tax reconciliation.

Attachment: portal_onboarding_checklist.xlsx

Kimberly Park
Billing Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

From: Sandra Lewis <sandra.lewis@helixhealth.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com, connor.obrien@redwood.com
Cc: tanders@helixhealth.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery: supplier onboarding + preferred channel

Thanks Connor and Kimberly — this is exactly what we needed. Helix confirms the hybrid approach with a pilot on Helix EU Ltd.

We attached the sample PO (Helix_PO_8892.pdf) and the VAT certificate for Helix EU Ltd (VAT_Certificate_Helix.pdf). Our IT team will share portal endpoints and the contact for SFTP in the next 24 hours.

Two quick clarifications:
- Test invoice: please use deal reference GF-2027-489 and mark the PDF with TEST so we can auto-reconcile.
- Billing disputes contact: we will use ap@helixhealth.com as primary and tanders@helixhealth.com for escalations.

We accept the proposed timeline and will aim for the 6/21 test. If your team needs an extended exception beyond 90 days for any legal entity, we’ll surface the request as part of the pilot review.

Attachments: Helix_PO_8892.pdf, VAT_Certificate_Helix.pdf

Best,
Sandra Lewis
Head of AP Operations
Helix Health
